dev_plan.description: Поэтапный план разработки TripVibe для команды из 5 разработчиков. Каждый этап завершается интеграционной точкой — работающим сквозным сценарием.

phase.name: Foundation
phase.goal: Общий каркас проекта, на котором параллельно строят все модули

task.title: Init Next.js project
task.details: Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, ESLint, Prettier. Структура директорий согласно project_context.md.

task.title: Database schema (Prisma)
task.details: Модели: User, Listing, Booking, Favorite, Review, Location, AvailabilityBlock. Seed-скрипт с 20+ listings в 3 городах.

task.title: Auth setup (NextAuth.js)
task.details: Email/password + Google OAuth. Middleware для защиты /profile, /checkout. Mock user для dev без OAuth.
task.acceptance: Login/logout работает, session доступна в Server Components

task.title: Shared types and URL utils
task.details: SearchParams Zod schema, parseSearchParams, buildSearchUrl. ListingPreview, ListingDetail base types.

task.title: Layout and design tokens
task.details: Root layout, header (logo, nav, auth), footer. Tailwind theme: цвета TripVibe, typography scale.
task.acceptance: Единый visual language на всех страницах-заглушках

phase.integration_checkpoint: Все 5 dev-ов могут начать работу в своих modules/ директориях. Seed data доступна. Auth работает.

phase.name: Parallel Module Development
phase.goal: Каждый разработчик реализует свой модуль независимо на mock/shared data

task.title: SearchBar on homepage
task.details: LocationAutocomplete (debounced fetch /api/locations/autocomplete), date pickers (checkIn/checkOut), guests selector, «Найти» button. Submit → navigate to /search with URL params.

task.title: Search results page
task.details: GET /api/listings/search with query params. Grid of ListingCard components. Empty state, loading skeleton.

task.title: Filters panel
task.details: Price slider (min/max), property type toggle buttons (apartment/house/room), amenities checkboxes (Wi-Fi, kitchen, parking). All sync to URL via nuqs/useSearchParams. Debounce 300ms.

task.title: Responsive and a11y
task.details: Mobile filter drawer, keyboard nav for autocomplete, ARIA labels.

task.title: Listing detail page
task.details: /listings/[id] — title, description, amenities list, host info, price. Pre-fill dates from URL search params.

task.title: ImageGallery
task.details: Full-width hero + thumbnail strip. Lightbox/modal for swipe/arrow navigation. Lazy loading, blur placeholder.

task.title: ListingMap
task.details: Mapbox map centered on listing lat/lng, single marker, responsive height.

task.title: AvailabilityCalendar
task.details: Fetch /api/listings/[id]/availability. Visual: green=free, red=booked, gray=past. Export component for reuse in checkout (Module 3).

task.title: AI Concierge widget
task.details: Chat UI on listing page. POST /api/listings/[id]/concierge. Vercel AI SDK streamText with system prompt containing description + amenities. Bot MUST NOT hallucinate — answer only from provided context.

task.title: Checkout page
task.details: /checkout/[listingId] — listing summary, date selection (reuse AvailabilityCalendar), guests count, PriceBreakdown component.

task.title: Price calculation
task.details: calculateTotalPrice(listing, checkIn, checkOut, guests). Show: N nights × price, cleaning fee, service fee, TOTAL. No hidden fees — all lines visible before payment.

task.title: Mock payment and booking creation
task.details: «Забронировать» → POST /api/bookings/mock-pay. Simulate 1.5s delay, create Booking with status=confirmed. Redirect to /profile/trips?success=true.

task.title: Validation
task.details: Zod schema for booking input. Check date overlap with existing bookings. Auth required — redirect to login if no session.

task.title: Profile layout and trips list
task.details: /profile — tabs: Upcoming, History, Favorites. TripsList: cards with listing image, dates, status badge, total price.

task.title: FavoriteButton component
task.details: Heart icon toggle. Optimistic UI update. POST/DELETE /api/favorites. Auth required. Export for use in search cards and listing page.

task.title: Favorites page
task.details: /profile/favorites — grid of favorited ListingPreview cards.

task.title: Trip detail actions
task.details: Upcoming: «Отменить» (status→cancelled). Completed: «Оставить отзыв» link.

task.title: ReviewForm
task.details: StarRating (1-5, interactive), text area, optional photo upload. Accessible from /profile/trips/[bookingId]/review. Only if booking.status === completed and no existing review.

task.title: Review submission API
task.details: POST /api/reviews — validate ownership, booking status, uniqueness. Trigger aggregateRating update on Listing.

task.title: ReviewList and RatingBadge
task.details: Paginated reviews on listing page. RatingBadge (avg + count) for cards. Export components for Module 1 and Module 2.

task.title: Rating aggregation
task.details: calculateAverageRating on review create/delete. Denormalized Listing.averageRating + reviewCount for search performance.

phase.integration_checkpoint: Каждый модуль работает изолированно со seed data. Stub-импорты между модулями заменены на реальные exports.

phase.name: Integration
phase.goal: Собрать все модули в единый работающий продукт

task.title: Cross-module imports
task.details: FavoriteButton → search ListingCard, listing page. AvailabilityCalendar → checkout page. ReviewList/RatingBadge → listing page, search cards. PriceBreakdown uses listing fees.

task.title: URL state end-to-end
task.details: Search params flow: home → results → listing → checkout. Browser back/forward preserves state. Shareable URLs work.

task.title: Auth guards
task.details: /checkout, /profile, /api/favorites, /api/bookings, /api/reviews require auth. Graceful redirect to login with returnUrl.

task.title: Error boundaries and empty states
task.details: 404 for invalid listingId. Empty search results. No favorites yet. Network error toasts.

task.title: Performance pass
task.details: Image optimization (next/image). Search API pagination. Debounced filters. React Query staleTime config.

phase.integration_checkpoint: E2E flow works: Search → Filter → View → Book → Profile → Review.

phase.name: Polish and QA

task.title: E2E tests (Playwright)
task.details: Critical paths: search flow, booking flow, favorite toggle, review submission. AI concierge returns response (smoke test with mock).

task.title: Mobile QA
task.details: All pages tested on 375px viewport. Filter drawer, gallery swipe, checkout.

task.title: AI Concierge demo polish
task.details: Suggested questions chips («Есть Wi-Fi?», «Как далеко до центра?»). Typing indicator during stream.

task.title: SEO and metadata
task.details: generateMetadata for listing pages. Open Graph images from listing photos.

task.title: README and env example
task.details: .env.example, setup instructions, module ownership map.

phase.integration_checkpoint: Demo-ready: investor can walk through full product on mobile and desktop.

risk.description: AvailabilityCalendar shared between listing and checkout — interface mismatch
risk.mitigation: Define AvailabilityCalendar props contract in Phase 0.4 shared types
Single SearchParams Zod schema owned by shared/, never extend per-module
Strict system prompt: answer ONLY from context; fallback «Не знаю» if not in data
Static map image fallback when NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN absent
